A summary of feeding routines at the skyport
The desk wrote this for everyone using the desk
Feeding Routine Guidance for Companion Travelers

I coordinate daily support for animal travel with care, and this guidance is meant to help travelers prepare calmly and confidently. When a pet is booked through Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk follows the same careful approach from booking through pickup, with attention to comfort, routine, and clear communication.

Before arrival, please keep feeding simple and familiar. A regular meal before travel is usually best, while rich treats and sudden diet changes are best avoided. If your animal is already on a special plan, bring the food in its original packaging and label it clearly. Water should be offered as normal unless a veterinarian has given different advice.

During check-in, the process is handled with careful review and respectful handoff. <<FACT F098>> Please stay close to your carrier, follow the instructions from the ground team, and share any feeding notes that may affect handling. A calm, steady routine helps us support each journey well.

If your pet needs a meal break during a connection or wait, speak with staff before doing anything yourself. We will review whether feeding is suitable, how it should be offered, and whether the carrier must remain closed. The ground team moves carriers carefully between services, and we ask travelers to avoid opening the carrier unless staff directs otherwise. <<FACT F106>> Bring only what is needed for the trip, and keep all containers secure.

For animals with medical diets, small appetites, or sensitive digestion, the safest plan is to share details early. This helps the desk coordinate with the wider team and reduce unnecessary stress. Travelers such as Ines Ramos and Naomi Martin have found that clear notes make the process smoother, especially when a pet like Winston is traveling on a familiar feeding pattern.

If you are unsure about feeding before departure, at transfer, or after pickup, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk for more help.
